name: JFrog MCP Server
description: Experimental Model Context Protocol server that enables access to JFrog Platform API capabilities including repository management, build tracking, artifact searching, and package security analysis.

rawRecord.description: Experimental Model Context Protocol server that enables access to JFrog Platform API capabilities including repository management, build tracking, artifact searching, and package security analysis.

PORT.description: Port number to use for SSE transport.

JFROG_URL.description: Base URL for your JFrog platform instance (e.g., https://acme.jfrog.io).

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR.

TRANSPORT.description: Transport mode to use, set to 'sse' to enable SSE transport.

CORS_ORIGIN.description: CORS origin allowed for SSE connections.

JFROG_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Your JFrog access token. Can be an Identity Token or an Access Token with appropriate permissions.

RECONNECT_DELAY_MS.description: Base delay in milliseconds between reconnection attempts.

MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS.description: Maximum number of reconnection attempts for SSE server.
